title: Distant views
description: Simply optimized Minecraft with huge view distance and shaders that will blow your mind. Meant to be used with low-mid ranged pcs. Enjoy :)
body:
🌄 Distant Views – Immersive Visual Overhaul

Step into a completely reimagined Minecraft experience. Distant Views transforms your world with breathtaking shaders, immersive sound design, and stunning distant terrain rendering — without changing the core vanilla gameplay you love.

✨ Stunning Shaders

Experience realistic lighting, dynamic shadows, volumetric clouds, glowing sunsets, and reflective water using **Minecraft shaders powered by Iris Shaders. Whether you're exploring lush forests or climbing mountain peaks, every moment looks cinematic.

🔊 Immersive Sound Design

Feel truly inside your world with enhanced ambient audio from AmbientSounds and dynamic sound physics powered by Sound Physics Remastered.
Hear wind sweep across plains, echoes bounce through caves, and rain patter realistically on different surfaces.

🌍 Massive Distant Views

See farther than ever before with advanced terrain rendering from Bobby a simple render mod. Mountains rise on the horizon, villages appear in the distance, and your builds can be admired from breathtaking viewpoints — all with optimized performance.

⚡ Optimized & Smooth

Built on a performance-focused foundation using Sodium, this pack ensures smooth gameplay even with high-end visuals enabled.

❔ Questions or bugs
